claims.claim: Six accepted primary commissioned records completed the bounded packaged workflow in their observed environments.
claims.limitation: Selected and compensated sample; not an adoption or population estimate.

claims.claim: The accepted cohort contained four Native Linux, one macOS, one WSL2 Ubuntu, four x86_64, two ARM64/AArch64, four Python 3.12, and two Python 3.13 environments.
claims.limitation: Observed environments only; no broad support claim.

claims.claim: Primary evaluator compensation totaled USD 22 and EUR 57, kept as separate currencies.
claims.limitation: Platform fees are excluded and currencies are not converted.

claims.claim: The WSL2 usability finding led to issue #60, PR #61, and merge commit 5e5396f. The remediation was documentation only.
claims.limitation: No post-fix run was added to the original denominator.

claims.claim: Compensation was fixed and did not depend on success, favorable feedback, public praise, or endorsement.
claims.limitation: Contracts and payment records are maintained outside the public repository.

claims.claim: The frozen protocol required one measured attempt, no rehearsal, no rerun after a meaningful failure, and no troubleshooting before evidence preservation.
claims.limitation: The archived protocol is maintained outside the public repository.

privacy_boundary: The public package uses cohort slots, public GitHub sources, local public data, and generic private archive references only. Private crosswalk contents and private records are not included.

sources.limitation: Payment and compensation records are archived privately.
